verdict.rationale: Reflect documents official Chrome and Safari extensions for bookmarking websites and capturing snippets from across the web, with the link and highlights automatically added to the daily note. That directly matches the browser-clipping capture flow. missing for 10: evidence of full-page or article-body clipping (beyond the link and highlighted snippets), choice of destination note other than the daily note, other browsers beyond Chrome/Safari, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can clip web pages, articles, and highlights from my browser straight into my notes with an official clipper or capture flow

citations.quote: Reflect lets you quickly bookmark websites and capture snippets from across the web using our Chrome extension and Safari extension.
The link and your highlights will automatically be added to your daily note.
